rows.name: Self-Destruct System
rows.sourceSafeSubset: Small and larger printed blast-dice cases have defined maximum-damage-based price
rows.resolutionEvidenceRequired: Need canonical treatment for Tiny, Diminutive and Fine: no collateral damage dice printed
rows.originalSourceHoldReason: Tiny and smaller produce no collateral-damage dice; source formula based on maximum damage does not establish a purchasable price/mass for those sizes.

rows.name: Climbing Claws
rows.sourceSafeSubset: Movement effect and Walking prerequisite verified; purchasing quote remains blocked
rows.resolutionEvidenceRequired: Decide whether Core p189 descriptive Walking multiplier supersedes Table 11-5 appendage multiplier
rows.originalSourceHoldReason: Printed prose and table disagree on price base

rows.name: Jump Servos
rows.sourceSafeSubset: Jump effects and Walking prerequisite verified; quote blocked
rows.resolutionEvidenceRequired: Decide precedence of Core p189 Walking cost vs Table 11-5 appendage cost
rows.originalSourceHoldReason: Printed prose and accessory table disagree on cost base

rows.name: Magnetic Feet
rows.sourceSafeSubset: Magnetic hull adhesion and eligible locomotion are defined; purchase price unresolved
rows.resolutionEvidenceRequired: Identify what appendage Table 11-5 means or published alternate price authority
rows.originalSourceHoldReason: Table uses appendage-based pricing without identifying which appendage belongs to the foot hardware

rows.name: Burrower Drive
rows.sourceSafeSubset: Small and larger drill damage can reference their self-destruct dice
rows.resolutionEvidenceRequired: Need Tiny/Diminutive/Fine drill damage authority, or explicit unsupported-size rule
rows.originalSourceHoldReason: Tiny and smaller have no published self-destruct collateral damage dice, so drill attack damage is unquantified for those sizes

rows.name: Projectile Hand
rows.sourceSafeSubset: Printed 2d8 nonlethal and disarm range remain source facts
rows.resolutionEvidenceRequired: Determine precedence of 250-credit descriptive installed price vs 2x selected appendage cost table
rows.originalSourceHoldReason: 250cr description and double appendage-cost table contradict for some chosen appendages

rows.name: Remote Limb Control
rows.sourceSafeSubset: Basic/Deluxe control limits are defined; no final quote
rows.resolutionEvidenceRequired: Resolve 1500/6000 descriptive prices vs 2x appendage Table 3-2, including tier distinction
rows.originalSourceHoldReason: Prose prices differ from table appendage-based price, and table does not specify basic/deluxe distinction

rows.name: Rocket Arm
rows.sourceSafeSubset: Printed 3d8 explosive effect and installation check remain facts
rows.resolutionEvidenceRequired: Resolve prose 2000 cr vs 4x appendage price Table 3-2
rows.originalSourceHoldReason: Printed 2000cr fixed price conflicts with four-times-appendage table

rows.name: Personality Downloader
rows.sourceSafeSubset: Illegal external dataport tool can be modeled with minimum price only; not fixed retail
rows.resolutionEvidenceRequired: A configured build with actual agreed price >= 5000 and weight >=2 kg is required
rows.originalSourceHoldReason: Custom item has published minimum price/weight, not exact price or mass for a configured sale

rows.name: Remote Receiver Jammer
rows.sourceSafeSubset: Use Computer action and target defense comparison defined
rows.resolutionEvidenceRequired: A published numeric effective range or explicit GM map-range ruling is required before auto targeting
rows.originalSourceHoldReason: Narrative says extremely short range but gives no numerical maximum, preventing deterministic range eligibility.

rows.name: Remote Receiver Signal Booster
rows.sourceSafeSubset: Ordinary +50% range extension defined; enhanced combined range held
rows.resolutionEvidenceRequired: Determine if DC30 1-hour up-to-100% boost replaces or stacks with passive +50%
rows.originalSourceHoldReason: Printed 50% passive extension and up-to-100% temporary extension lack explicit combination/precedence.

rows.name: Concealed Item
rows.sourceSafeSubset: Visibility/disguise benefits and deployment action are source facts
rows.resolutionEvidenceRequired: Select hosted weapon/tool plus appendage/storage, then resolve printed doubling grouping and GM adjustment
rows.originalSourceHoldReason: The composite cost expression has ambiguous multiplication grouping and may be adjusted by the GM; exact host/item price not certified.

rows.name: Droid Oil Bath
rows.sourceSafeSubset: External equipment rather than installed chassis system established
rows.resolutionEvidenceRequired: Resolve fixed 500-cr table entry vs varying size-based descriptive prices
rows.originalSourceHoldReason: Printed Table 3-2 500-credit price conflicts with 100/1,000/5,000/10,000 size-price tiers in prose. External ownership also must be respected.

rows.name: Earphone Binary-to-Basic Translator
rows.sourceSafeSubset: Basic version has printed entry; premium earbud variant not quoted
rows.resolutionEvidenceRequired: Official source or GM-established premium price and weight needed
rows.originalSourceHoldReason: Text describes more expensive earbud version but prints no price or differentiated mass for that version.

rows.name: Emergency Oxygen Supply
rows.sourceSafeSubset: Availability and function described; table weight label lacks unit
rows.resolutionEvidenceRequired: Printed-authority mass unit, not assumed kg, required for encumbrance
rows.originalSourceHoldReason: Table 3-2 weight cell prints 20 without mass unit, and prose does not clarify. Cannot certify physical mass or burden.

rows.name: Interference Generator
rows.sourceSafeSubset: Base version has a printed price; Deluxe requires separate modeling
rows.resolutionEvidenceRequired: Printed source or GM-established Deluxe price and mass
rows.originalSourceHoldReason: Deluxe model expands protection to video/holo but does not have separately printed price/weight; no typed purchasable deluxe variant certified.

rows.name: Taser
rows.sourceSafeSubset: Nonlethal/ion-like mode description preserved
rows.resolutionEvidenceRequired: Find explicit official weapon damage entry or rules cross-reference before damage automation
rows.originalSourceHoldReason: Published SGD p63 description gives weapon behavior but no explicit ranged or melee damage dice; complete executable attack specification requires another printed weapon source/rule cross-reference.

rows.name: Video Screen
rows.sourceSafeSubset: Published area-based price/weight formulas can be represented symbolically
rows.resolutionEvidenceRequired: Actual selected area in square millimeters must be supplied; 50-500 mm extent alone does not identify area
rows.originalSourceHoldReason: The book states screen sizes vary 50–500mm but does not specify whether this measures width, height or diagonal; no individual screen area is defined, so an exact configured price/mass needs dimensions.

policy: Do not block validated non-conflicting variants automatically; block only configurations dependent on unresolved source facts
Do not treat permissive GM decisions as official printed rules
Protect source precedences: official errata overrides original Core book; unresolved Core/SGD table-prose conflicts remain HOLD
No future price may default to zero when no exact canonical formula can quote it
A controller, carried device, bath or vehicle station is not installedSystem solely by presence in catalog
